purpose: Catalog of the transactional email designs and their notification content contracts. Documentation for the backend notification owner; not a production frontend contract. Backend source is authoritative for NotificationType values and payload keys.

roles.6-emails/: Canonical visual reference: 88 files = 22 templates x desktop/mobile x light/dark, each with an inbox strip (subject, sender, preheader).
roles.email-pages/live/: Responsive email HTML (22 files): table layout, inline styles, prefers-color-scheme and [data-ogsc] dark rules, 480px breakpoint. Starting point for client evaluation, not production templates.
roles.email-pages/screens/: Locked preview exports (88 files). Identical to 6-emails/ except the preview page background. Never deploy as email HTML.
roles.email-pages/index.html: Gallery: template name, subject, Existing/Proposed status and NotificationType per template.

designSource.counting: 22 templates. Device/theme variants and the duplicated screens/ exports are not additional notification types or screens.

backendSource.payload: EmailNotificationContent(To, Dictionary<string,string> Content, Cc, Bcc) — all values are strings

coverageStatuses: Backend trigger exists but template missing

variableFields.status: backend-key = key already used by the backend template or producer; proposed = new key for the follow-up ticket
variableFields.missing: Required behaviour when the value is absent

formats.dateTimeUtc: Absolute UTC date and time, e.g. '25 Nov 2026 · 11:30 UTC' (en). Today the backend formats 'dddd, MMMM d, yyyy at h:mm tt UTC (relative)'; drop the relative part because it is computed at send time and is wrong when read later.
formats.date: Absolute date, e.g. '14 Dec 2026' (en); localize by SendNotificationCommand.Language.
formats.money: Formatted by the backend from decimal + ISO 4217 currency with the currency's minor units. The design mixes 'NGN 15,000.00' and '₦15,000.00'; pick one convention.
formats.otp: 6 numeric digits. Display grouped '629 044' for readability; the plain-text part should show the ungrouped code. Grouping is presentation only (see FE-UI-020 note in the handoff).
formats.url: Absolute https URL built by the backend from configured portal base URLs and a fixed path allowlist; HTML-attribute encoded; no secrets or personal data.
